title: Consume a qualified scalar-task enclosure without changing its meaning
statement: For a named real task T on a nonempty admissible model family, warranted L<=T<=U under qualification E certifies T<=c if U<=c and T>c if L>c, with c in the same units. A straddling loose enclosure alone does not prove actual ambiguity. If both attained task extremizers survive an observation fibre, its sharp task interval is unchanged. This setwise statement is distinct from Bayesian value.

requires: Receive the actual named task, nonempty admissible family, warranted bounds (an unbounded side may be infinite), governing qualification/event and costs, and an actual threshold in matching units. For the observation branch, receive matching attained endpoint witnesses that remain admissible in the justified exact or noisy fibre. No bound, observation, sensor, probability model or physical input is acquired by naming this interface.
provides: A threshold conclusion conditional on the same warranted input bounds and qualification
A witness-based test that a new observation leaves a sharp task interval unchanged
assumptions: No conversion between different tasks, units, support, posterior weights or validity events is inferred. A common consumer creates navigation among providers, not a transfer between them. A loose straddling interval is only unresolved by those bounds; actual ambiguity requires witnesses on both sides. Unchanged robust support bounds can coexist with improved Bayes risk. A small remaining-benefit bound is not a small absolute-error guarantee. No working device, measured effect, historical novelty or practical advantage is established.
costs: All producer bound/observation acquisition, calibration, arithmetic/precision, trials, preparation/reset and physical operation costs remain. The consumer adds comparisons of supplied bounds and threshold; it is not a free inference oracle. Probabilistic validity retains the original event and confidence; no independence or unconditional certainty is invented.
contract.units: The named task and threshold use the same source-defined units. A dimensionless expected risk, regret, signed response, length and heat deficit remain different quantities.
contract.obstruction: An attractive observation, matching unit label or shared consumer does not establish the needed source bounds or a provider-to-provider transfer.

input_slots.description: A named task with warranted lower/upper bounds, matching units, actual model/observation qualification and paid acquisition. Infinite missing sides remain explicit.

body: U<=c implies T<=c throughout the stated model family; L>c implies T>c. A straddling loose enclosure does not establish witnesses on both sides. Two attained endpoint witnesses that survive the actual observation fibre preserve the sharp interval. Unchanged setwise support does not imply unchanged Bayes value: the noisy fair-bit counterexample retains support while improving mean classification error.

evidence.quote: # Qualified scalar bounds as a decision interface
evidence.range_scope: Owner-derived complete elementary interface proof, including qualification, strict threshold boundary, extremizer persistence and the Bayes-value counterexample; no novelty or physical acquisition claim.

review.scope: Completed owner review of this exact mathematical interface and its real assumptions; no input acquisition or physical/capability promotion.
